description:
deskhand's contract is published at https://github.com/mattsp1290/deskhand/blob/contract-v0.11-draft/docs/contract.md (tag contract-v0.11-draft), MCP revision 2026-07-28. The owner approved these amendments to the shared contract on 2026-11-14:
1. Screenshot limits: long edge <= 2576 px, at most 3,588,000 px (4784 visual tokens), at most 3,750,000 raw image bytes (base64 <= 5 MB on any provider). deskhand never returns a larger image.
2. New state 'gated': every tool except status (and lease release) refused while the LAN-gate allowance is missing/expired.
3. No node-IP allowlist inside deskhand; pf anchor + mTLS + token are the access control.
4. Lease changes move to a sixth tool 'lease' (acquire/renew/release with holder_id); status is a pure read with an optional operation lookup for lost responses (contract 12.5).
Crew client work: speak MCP 2026-07-28 (params._meta protocol version required), treat 'lease' as an effect, send its call ID as operation_id, use the status operation lookup instead of retrying an uncertain effect, mint a per-caller holder_id. Unblocks deskhand-bw22.
title: Adopt deskhand contract 0.11-draft (amendments approved 2026-11-14)
